title: Beyond Benchmarking: Scenario-Based Evaluation of Large Language Models for Personalized Learning
abstract: arXiv:2509.05346v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: While large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being adopted to support personalized learning, there remains limited understanding of how their pedagogical behaviors differ in authentic learning scenarios. Existing evaluation practices often emphasize benchmark scores and overall model rankings, but such approaches usually provide limited insight into how LLMs diagnose student understanding and generate personalized guidance. This study proposes a scenario-based evaluation framework for closely examining LLM behavior in personalized learning support. Using a post-class tutoring setting as an illustrative example, a dataset comprising a student's responses to a set of data structures questions is provided to multiple LLMs. Each model is required to identify the underlying knowledge concepts, infer the student's mastery profile, and generate personalized guidance for improvement. translated_title: 超越基准测试：基于场景的大型语言模型个性化学习评估
translated_abstract: arXiv:2509.05346v3 公告类型：替换  摘要：虽然大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于支持个性化学习，但对其在教学场景中的教学行为差异仍缺乏深入了解。现有的评估实践往往强调基准分数和模型整体排名，但这种方法通常对LLMs如何诊断学生理解并生成个性化指导提供的洞察有限。本研究提出了一种基于场景的评估框架，用于密切检查LLMs在个性化学习支持中的行为。以一个课后辅导场景作为示例，向多个LLMs提供了一组包含学生对数据结构问题回答的数据集。每个模型需要识别潜在的知识概念，推断学生的掌握情况，并生成个性化的改进指导。为支持一致、可重复和可扩展的共同评估...
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于真实学习场景的评估框架，用于深入分析大型语言模型在个性化学习中的教学行为，超越了传统基准测试的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a scenario-based evaluation framework to deeply analyze LLMs' pedagogical behaviors in personalized learning, going beyond traditional benchmark limitations.
